question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When the strain gauge-elastic member combination is used for weighing, it is called a ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Load cell**(Load Cell)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Load cell__ is a transducer that converts force into an electrical signal.
 
• In a weighing system, the strain gauge-elastic member combination is used to measure weight accurately.
 
• The load cell uses strain gauges that are bonded to a spring element to detect deformations.
 
• The measured force is proportional to the electrical output produced by the strain gauge.
 
• It is commonly used in industrial weighing systems, such as platform scales and tank weighing systems.
 
• Load cells are designed for high precision and reliability in force measurement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Linear Variable Differential Transformer (L.V.D.T.):**
 
 
• It is an electromechanical device used to measure displacement.
 
• It works based on the principle of mutual induction between primary and secondary windings.
 
 
 
• **Piezoelectric Transducer:**
 
 
• It converts mechanical stress into an electrical charge using piezoelectric materials like quartz.
 
• It is widely used in dynamic measurements such as vibration and pressure sensing.
 
 
 
• **Capacitive Transducer:**
 
 
• It works based on changes in capacitance caused by variations in distance or dielectric constant.
 
• It is used for measuring displacement, pressure, and level.
